reference.format: per seed, one grid per located city: centre (the located start chunk); grid (the compared chunks, inclusive); cities: every end_city start whose pieces reach the grid, with its pieces [template, rotation, overwrite, min x, y, z, max x, y, z] in Java's order; chunks: as end_decoration.json's rows, then the end stone count and hash and the chorus count and hash of the columns outside every piece's box; chorus_bases and gateways in the grid
sources: the pinned dedicated server run on a new world per seed: 'execute in minecraft:the_end positioned X 64 Z run locate structure minecraft:end_city' from each origin, 'forceload add' on the chunks within 7 of each city's start chunk, 'save-all flush', then the End's region files read back (chunks, their end_city References and the starts' pieces)
